result.title: Safe by Benchmark, Unsafe in Practice: Lessons from 1331 Child-Related AI Incidents
result.summary: AI systems are increasingly present in children's everyday environments: education, entertainment, social networks, and toys. Their safety is typically assessed at the model level, through benchmarks, red-teaming, and content filtering. However, most AI harm taxonomies lack child-specific evidence and under-specify developmental harm and the stakeholder asymmetries unique to minors. Building on prior taxonomies, we construct a child-centered harm taxonomy mapped to sociotechnical failure modes. We curate and code 1331 publicly reported child-related AI incidents, annotating internal and external harm types and the failure mode implicated in each incident. Our analysis reveals which harms are most prevalent in public reporting, how individual-level and population-level harms relate, and which failures are most often coded alongside harm. We find that harm concentrates in representational, dignity-related, and psychological categories, and co-occurs most often with deployment-context, governance, and misuse failures rather than model defects. Harm to an individual child is also frequently linked to population-level harm, reaching children who never interacted with the system. These findings suggest that model-level evaluations, while necessary, cannot by themselves anticipate the harm pathways most often documented for children. We conclude with actionable implications emphasizing mitigations beyond model-level safeguards such as content filtering: age assurance, consent verification for depiction, safety-by-design UX constraints, incident disclosure norms, and auditing regimes targeting developmental risk. Privacy-minimized annotations, a codebook, and documentation are available at https://github.com/The-Responsible-AI-Initiative/KidAID.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建以儿童为中心的 AI 危害分类体系，并对 1331 起公开报告的儿童相关 AI 事件进行编码分析，指出危害多集中于表征、尊严与心理层面，并与部署情境、治理和滥用失效共现，而非模型缺陷。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于 AI 安全治理与事件审计，未涉及视觉或多模态推理的内部状态、证据筛选与决策机制，也无可供迁移的 latent 表示或训练线索，故排除。
